notes: Technical note comparing farmers' qualitative scores of five commercial wheat bran types (Tigray, Ethiopia; 30 dairy farmers) with laboratory quality parameters. Wheat bran supplementation is the background use, not an intervention studied against a basal diet, so it does not meet feed_mgmt as an intervention. It would also fail no_outcome_data: no costs/returns, adoption or carbon values (only feed chemistry, rank scores and Spearman correlations).
